description: Use this when a person has picked a time and wants to go ahead. Creates a reference and, where the diary allows it, holds the time for ten minutes. Takes no personal details. Returns a link the person opens to enter their details, confirm and pay. Nothing is booked or charged by this call.

agent.description: Optional. Your name as an assistant, e.g. "chatgpt" or "claude". Attribution only.

city.description: Where the person wants to be seen, e.g. London, Dubai, Riyadh. Default London.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, on the city's own calendar.

mode.description: Optional. In the clinic, at home, by video or by phone.

service.description: The service key from find_care, find_blood_tests or find_scans.

specialist.description: Optional. The slug from find_specialists, to book that doctor.

time.description: The time, HH:MM, on the city's own clock, from get_times.

name: hold_time
title: Hold a time
